package llmorgsettings

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"net"
	"os"
	"strings"
	"testing"
)

func pctAll(s string) string {
	var out strings.Builder
	for i := 0; i < len(s); i++ {
		out.WriteString("%" + strings.ToUpper(hex.EncodeToString([]byte{s[i]})))
	}
	return out.String()
}

func layers(s string, n int) string {
	for i := 0; i < n; i++ {
		s = pctAll(s)
	}
	return s
}

func TestGenerateBaseURLKeyOracle(t *testing.T) {
	out := os.Getenv("ORACLE_OUT")
	if out == "" {
		t.Skip("ORACLE_OUT unset")
	}
	orig := hostResolver
	hostResolver = func(context.Context, string) ([]net.IP, error) { return []net.IP{net.ParseIP("93.184.216.34")}, nil }
	defer func() { hostResolver = orig }()

	keys := []string{"abc", "abcdefg", "sk-12345", "SK-MixedCase-0123456789", "sk-synth-test-0123456789ABCDEF", "synthetic/key+with=special/chars==",
		"pct%25key-0123456789", "key-with-\u00e9-\u00fc-0123456789", "sk-" + strings.Repeat("synthetic0123456789", 10)}
	type row [4]any
	var rows []row
	add := func(ki int, url string) {
		hit := CarriesKey(KeyLeakForms(keys[ki]), url)
		ok, reason, _ := ValidateBaseURLChecked(context.Background(), url)
		userinfo := !ok && reason == "LLM base_url must not include userinfo"
		rows = append(rows, row{ki, url, hit, userinfo})
	}
	place := func(p int, form string) string {
		switch p {
		case 0:
			return "https://" + form + "@h.example.invalid/v1"
		case 1:
			return "https://" + form + ".h.example.invalid/v1"
		case 2:
			return "https://h.example.invalid/v1/" + form
		case 3:
			return "https://h.example.invalid/v1?k=" + form
		}
		return "https://h.example.invalid/v1#" + form
	}
	for ki, key := range keys {
		forms := append([]string{}, KeyLeakForms(key)...)
		forms = append(forms, key, strings.ToUpper(key), strings.ToLower(key), hex.EncodeToString([]byte(key)), strings.ToUpper(hex.EncodeToString([]byte(key))))
		for fi, form := range forms {
			ns := []int{0, 1}
			if len(form) <= 16 {
				ns = []int{0, 1, 2, 4, 5}
			}
			if len(key) > 64 {
				ns = []int{0}
			}
			for li, n := range ns {
				add(ki, place((fi+li)%5, layers(form, n)))
			}
		}
		for p := 0; p < 5; p++ {
			ns := []int{0, 1}
			if len(key) <= 16 {
				ns = []int{0, 1, 3, 4, 5}
			}
			if len(key) > 64 {
				ns = []int{0}
			}
			for _, n := range ns {
				add(ki, place(p, layers(key, n)))
			}
		}
		if len(key) <= 40 {
			add(ki, place(2, layers(key, 4)))
		}
		if len(key) <= 16 {
			add(ki, place(2, layers(key, 5)))
		}
		half := key[:len(key)/2]
		for _, url := range []string{
			"https://h.example.invalid/v1",
			"https://h.example.invalid/openai/deployments/d?api-version=2024-02-01",
			"https://api.cloudflare.com/client/v4/accounts/0123456789abcdef0123456789abcdef/ai/v1",
			"https://h.example.invalid/v1/" + half,
			"https://h.example.invalid/v1/" + key[:len(key)-1],
			"https://h.example.invalid/v1/" + key[1:],
			"https://h.example.invalid/%zz/" + layers(key, 1),
			"https://h.example.invalid/100%",
			"https://h.example.invalid/v1?k=" + layers("other-"+key, 2),
			"https://h.example.invalid/v1/" + strings.Repeat("x", 40),
		} {
			add(ki, url)
		}
	}
	for _, url := range []string{
		"https://user:pass@h.example.invalid/v1",
		"https://u@h.example.invalid/v1",
		"https://:@h.example.invalid/v1",
		"https://h.example.invalid/a@b",
		"https://h.example.invalid/v1?next=a@b",
		"https://h.example.invalid/v1#a@b",
		"https://a@b@h.example.invalid/v1",
		"https://user:" + layers("sk-12345", 1) + "@h.example.invalid/v1",
		"//user:pass@h.example.invalid/v1",
		"//u@h.example.invalid/v1",
		"//h.example.invalid/v1",
		"//h.example.invalid/v1?next=a@b",
		"https://h.example.invalid/v1\t?x=1",
		"https://h.example.invalid/\nv1",
		"https://u@h.example.invalid/\tv1",
	} {
		add(2, url)
	}
	doc := map[string]any{
		"ops_commit": "69e7179d70573959df2586f1d8ba090e30fccb01",
		"keys":       keys,
		"columns":    []string{"key_index", "base_url", "ops_key_hit", "ops_refuses_userinfo"},
		"rows":       rows,
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(doc)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(out, append(encoded, '\n'), 0o600); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	t.Logf("rows=%d", len(rows))
}
